verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party way for users to define event-triggered rules or automations. Order webhooks only push events to an endpoint, and the subscriber has to build any rule logic, so they are a developer building block. UCP_ON_ESCALATION is a single fixed CLI behavior, not a user-definable rule. AP2's 'pre-defined boundaries' constrain transactions rather than trigger actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
